about: The phone apps, in the order the phone shows them. Only what a real phone is for (calls, messages, Crab, chat) is here: what is there to read (the Cẩm nang, the map, quests, achievements, the profile) is in the game's own menu, the Sổ tay (src/game/notebook/), which needs no phone (docs/design/10-story.md, section 6). An app with requires is on a character's phone only when it has every one of those capabilities (server/content/archetypes.json). Shared by the server, which sends each player its list, and the game (src/game/phone/), which draws each app by its id and hides ids it does not know.
